src='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==0 and (i,j) not in seen:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); seen.add((i,j)); c=[]
                while q:
                    y,x=q.popleft(); c.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        n=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=n[0]<h and 0<=n[1]<w and g[n[0]][n[1]]==0 and n not in seen:
                            seen.add(n); q.append(n)
                comps.append(c)
    for c,v in [(max(comps,key=len),8),(min(comps,key=len),7)]:
        for y,x in c: g[y][x]=v
    return g
'''
